$comment: Herman Miller (office seating and furniture) denies every page fetch from this network: plain HTTP, headless Chrome and AvalAI's page fetch all return ACCESS_DENIED. So the site uses the default engine (APP_DEFAULT_ENGINE, ai-crawler-avalai on this instance) with ai_fetch web_search; the shop is never contacted and the values are unverified (AI_UNVERIFIED), so prices may be out of date. Engines tried on 2026-11-19: http and browser: ACCESS_DENIED; ai_fetch http and browser: ACCESS_DENIED; web_search: success (7 specs, 6 features, 564+556 tokens). Needs APP_AI_CRAWLER_ENABLED with an AvalAI key.
